info.title: inKind Hotels API
info.description: Unified API for Hotels and Bookings.

get.description: Search hotels by country, latitude and longitude, hotel IDs, or free text. A city filter must be combined with one of these search options.

parameters.name: hotel_ids
parameters.description: Look up a batch of inKind hotel identifiers.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in meters. Requires latitude and longitude.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City filter. Requires a search selector such as country or query.

parameters.name: min_rating
parameters.description: Minimum hotel review score on a scale of 0 to 10.

X-Request-ID.description: Correlation identifier for this HTTP attempt.

get.description: Return descriptive property content. Optional unavailable fields are omitted; this response does not establish availability or a booking price.

X-Request-ID.description: Correlation identifier for this HTTP attempt.

get.description: Return a page of reviews for the hotel.

X-Request-ID.description: Correlation identifier for this HTTP attempt.

post.description: Search hotel offers for the requested stay and guests. Results include room details, prices, Cash Back, and cancellation policies.

X-Request-ID.description: Correlation identifier for this HTTP attempt.

post.description: Create a quote for a selected hotel offer with current pricing, Cash Back, room details, and cancellation policies. Review the returned terms before booking, as they may differ from the original offer. Creating a quote does not reserve rooms or guarantee availability. Each request revalidates the offer and may return a different quote ID or updated terms. If the offer is no longer available, a 409 offer_unavailable response indicates that a new offer must be selected.

X-Request-ID.description: Correlation identifier for this HTTP attempt.

get.description: Retrieve a quote by its ID, including pricing, Cash Back, room details, and cancellation policies. Review the returned terms before booking. Retrieving a quote does not change its terms, reserve rooms, or guarantee availability. Missing quotes and quotes belonging to another customer return 404.

X-Request-ID.description: Correlation identifier for this HTTP attempt.

post.description: Create a booking from a quote and saved payment source. Poll the returned booking for updates and reuse the original idempotency key when retrying. The booking holder is the authenticated customer.

payment_source_id.description: Existing saved payment source ID owned by the authenticated customer.

quote_id.description: Identifier of the quote to accept.

X-Request-ID.description: Correlation identifier for this HTTP attempt.

get.description: Return a page of the authenticated customer's bookings, including pending and unsuccessful booking attempts.

X-Request-ID.description: Correlation identifier for this HTTP attempt.

get.description: Retrieve booking details, processing stage, reservation and transaction status, and the last update time. Details reflect the last known status. Available to the booking owner; missing bookings and bookings belonging to another customer return 404.

X-Request-ID.description: Correlation identifier for this HTTP attempt.

patch.description: The booking owner can request changes to the holder's name or contact details. Omitted fields remain unchanged. Acceptance does not mean the update has been confirmed.

X-Request-ID.description: Correlation identifier for this HTTP attempt.

delete.description: Request cancellation under the booking's cancellation terms. Cancellation and refund completion are reported separately. The booking remains available after cancellation. Available to the booking owner and explicitly authorized support accounts.

X-Request-ID.description: Correlation identifier for this HTTP attempt.

post.description: Prepare replacement quotes at the same hotel for changed dates or guest counts. Each quote is tied to the original booking and includes current prices and cancellation terms. Review those terms before accepting the replacement.

X-Request-ID.description: Correlation identifier for this HTTP attempt.

BearerAuth.description: Bearer access token authorized to use the Hotels API.

Cursor.description: Opaque cursor bound to the original search criteria, ordering, and page size. Invalid cursors return 400 invalid_cursor.

IdempotencyKey.description: Opaque key associated with this actor and operation for the related resource’s lifetime. Matching retries return the same operation; conflicting contents return 409.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Requested page size. Defaults to 200, with a maximum of 5000.

original_id.description: Original booking ID if this booking was rebooked.

hotel.description: Fulfilled hotel details when supplied; otherwise the accepted hotel snapshot.

stay.description: Fulfilled stay when supplied; omitted details retain accepted terms.

holder.description: Fulfilled booking holder when supplied; omitted contact fields retain accepted customer contact.

rooms.description: Fulfilled room content and guests matched to the accepted occupancy index. Omitted details retain accepted terms; customer room prices stay immutable.

price.description: Immutable accepted customer price and Cash Back; supplier fulfillment does not reprice the booking.

policies.description: Supplier fulfillment cancellation policies when available; otherwise the accepted policies.

occupancy_index.description: One-based room occupancy index. Use the corresponding index from the offer or quote.
One-based room occupancy index. Use the corresponding index from the offer or quote.

BookingStatus.description: Owned booking outcome. Confirmation requires both supplier confirmation and completed customer payment. needs_attention indicates an unresolved outcome requiring reconciliation.

id.description: Owned Core payment transaction identifier when available.

deadline.description: Cancellation cutoff expressed as a timezone-qualified date-time.

price.description: Monetary cancellation penalty in currency minor units.

refundable.description: Whether cancellation permits a refund, subject to the listed penalties. The final card refund may differ from the refundable room amount.

CashBack.description: Cash Back earned on the subtotal excluding included taxes and fees, in the same currency as total.

percent.description: Cash Back percentage expressed in whole percentage points.

from.description: Earliest check-in time in the property's local time, preserving supplied display text.

until.description: Latest check-in time in the property's local time, preserving supplied display text.

time.description: Standard check-out time in the property's local time, preserving supplied display text.

allowed.description: Whether children are allowed. Omitted when reliable information is unavailable.

allOf.description: A tax or fee with a flat amount and currency in minor units.

included.description: True when already included in Price.total; false when excluded from total and payable at check-in.

description.description: Customer-facing name or description of the tax or fee.

hotel_ids.description: Look up a batch of inKind hotel identifiers.

GetRatesCommonRequest.description: All supplied hotel quality filters must be satisfied by the returned hotel fields.

min_reviews.description: Minimum number of hotel reviews. Hotels without a known review count are excluded when this filter is supplied.

min_rating.description: Minimum hotel review score on a scale of 0 to 10.

timeout.description: Maximum collection time in seconds before returning available rates. Values above 60 are treated as 60. Response delivery may take slightly longer.

limit_per_hotel.description: Maximum number of rates returned per hotel.

sort.description: Sorts offers within each hotel and hotels by their first offer. Criteria are applied in order, with later criteria breaking ties. Sorting applies to the returned page, not all matching hotels. recommended requests recommended results; other criteria order those results by price, Cash Back, or hotel guest review score. Rating ties for offers within a hotel. Omitted or empty uses recommendation order.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor bound to the original search criteria, ordering, and page size. Invalid cursors return 400 invalid_cursor.

limit.description: Requested page size. Defaults to 200, with a maximum of 5000.

minimum_rooms.description: Minimum number of rooms for a group booking. Omitted when unknown.

scale.description: Rating scale; normalization is still a draft decision.

rooms.description: Descriptive room types at this hotel.

occupancy_index.description: One-based room occupancy index. Use the corresponding index from the offer or quote.

HotelPolicies.description: Known hotel policies keyed by category. Unavailable policies and unknown structured facts are omitted.

HotelRoom.description: Descriptive content for a hotel room type.

name.example: Queen Room with Two Queen Beds - Hearing Accessible

description.description: Description of the room and its features.

unit.description: Area unit; square meters are represented as sqm.

occupancy.description: Maximum guest capacities. Only known limits are included. Adult and child limits must not be added to infer total capacity. These limits do not establish availability for a requested stay.

bed_relation.description: NONE means no relation applies. AND means all listed beds are present together. OR means the listed beds are alternatives. COMPLEX means the configuration combines relationships that cannot be expressed by a single AND or OR.

max_occupancy.description: Maximum number of guests allowed in this room.

remarks.description: Special remarks related to the booking or room type.

Id.description: Opaque inKind identifier. Must contain a non-whitespace character and must not contain commas. Clients must not interpret its encoding.

amount.description: Amount in the currency’s minor units.

next_cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor. Omitted when there are no further results.

available.description: Whether parking is available. Omitted when reliable information is unavailable.

allowed.description: Whether pets are allowed. Omitted when reliable information is unavailable.

Policy.description: Common hotel policy information. Optional text is omitted when unavailable.

Price.description: Customer-facing price for a room or for all rooms and nights in an offer, quote, or booking.

total.description: Rate plus all fees marked included. Excludes fees payable at check-in and does not subtract Cash Back.

cash_back.description: Cash Back earned on the subtotal excluding included taxes and fees, in the same currency as total.

fees.description: Breakdown of included taxes and fees and additional charges payable at check-in. Empty when there are no fees.

reviewed_on.description: Review calendar date; no timezone is inferred.

field.description: Ordering criterion: recommended for recommended results, price for the total stay price, cash_back_total for the Cash Back amount, cash_back_percent for the Cash Back percentage, or rating for the hotel guest review score.

Stay.description: Dates and total guest and pet counts for a stay. Check-out must be after check-in, and the number of adults must be at least the number of rooms.

rooms.description: Number of rooms. Guests are distributed evenly, with at least one adult per room.

adults.description: Total number of adults across all rooms.

children.description: Total number of children across all rooms.

pets.description: Total number of pets across all rooms. Positive counts restrict rate searches to supplier-classified pet-friendly hotels.
